note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a IND 6 + Third Schedule; A06b IND 6 + Third Schedule; L05 IND 9): ordinary naturalisation after 12 years' residence (the 12 months before the application and 11 of the 14 years before them; the dataset's own count is 11); the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, India, 2024
sources.said: Person is not an illegal migrant and has been resident in India or abroad in the service of India for 12 months immediately prior to the application, as well as during 11 out of 14 years predating the 12-month period Intent to reside in India or to enter or continue in the service of India required. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country.
